capabilities: Replace matches within a selected scope without prefilling the query field
Search with plain text or JavaScript regular expressions including capture groups
Highlight the selection scope and matches with configurable colors
Reuse saved find-and-replace combos via history, favorites, and a shortcut
Resize, reposition, and adjust opacity and font size of the floating panel
extras: Desktop-only (requires the floating overlay). Caps at 2000 matches per scope; the panel is not persisted across app restarts and closes when switching notes.
intentEvidence: A focused find-and-replace panel for Obsidian that removes the most annoying extra step: selected text is never copied into the query field.
motivation: The author built it to remove the needless cleanup step where selected text is copied into the query field and must be deleted before searching.
problem: Obsidian's built-in find and replace copies the selected text into the query field, forcing users to delete it before typing their real query.
summary: Floating find-and-replace panel that keeps selected text as the search scope, with an empty query field, regex support, and reusable search history.
